title: Bill Colby's death before delivering a zero-point device
summary: Steven Greer tells of Bill Colby's death before delivering a zero-point device, about 1996 at Washington, D.C., and says they saw it or took part. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: You know, when Bill KBY, who had been read into this, tried to get a zero point device to us

plain: Steven Greer, a doctor who campaigns for the government to reveal what it knows about UFOs, told this on Jesse Michels' podcast. He says that in 1996 William Colby, a former head of the CIA who Greer says had been told about these secrets, tried to get his group a "zero-point device", a machine said to draw energy from empty space. As Greer tells it, Colby died, near a river south of Washington, before the device could be handed over. If true, it would suggest that such technology exists and is being held back.
